description: Lists the account's documents, newest first: the title, when it was created, how many tracked links point at it, and its document id. A document with no links appears here and not in list_shares, which lists only documents that have been sent. It returns no document contents. Returns at most 50 per call; the `before` cursor pages back through older documents.

before.description: Cursor for the next page: the `next_before` value printed at the end of a previous list_documents result, of the form <created_at>|<document id>. Its exact value selects the next page; omission selects the most recent documents.

name: list_documents
title: List documents on this account
